title: Twin Grakatas
extract:
The Twin Grakatas are the akimbo secondary variant of the primary  Grakata assault rifle. Despite its lackluster base damage, it possesses a very high critical chance, critical multiplier and extreme fire rate, making this weapon deceptively powerful. It also fires two bullets at once due to its innate multishot, but in turn, it depletes its high ammo pool alarmingly quickly. It is also Clem's weapon of choice and are also used by Emperyan Evicirators.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Innate multishot of 2 bullets, and consumes 2 ammo per shot.
Functionally acts as double fire-rate.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Innate multishot provides doubled damage output and status output.
Negligible recoil.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average average number of procs per shot (0.33)
High crit chance (25.00%)
High burst DPS (570)
Very high fire rate (20.00 attacks/sec)
High multishot (2)
High crit multiplier (2.70x)
Very high average number of crits per shot (0.5)
Above average accuracy (2.00° to 5.00°)
Very high magazine size (120)
Very high ammo pickup (60)
Very high ammo max (1,200)
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Very low base damage, reliant on its high critical damage potential. Ill-suited against Object-based health as it nullifies any critical hits.
Extremely poor ammo efficiency. Further reinforced by the double consumption of ammo.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low reload speed (3.00 s)
Very low total damage (20)
Below average status chance (16.50%)
Low damage per shot (28.5)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
The Twin Grakata's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Notes
The Twin Grakatas fire two bullets per shot. This means that the actual fire rate is double that of the listed fire rate.
The total credit cost of crafting the Twin Grakatas, including the blueprint and the building costs of its two constituent Grakatas, is  195,000.
Compared to the Grakata, each individual bullet will deal 4  Impact, 3.35  Puncture, and 2.65  Slash, which is less damage per bullet than the Grakata, but fires two of these at once, resulting in far more DPS. The weapon also has the advantage of a much more efficient physical damage mod as well as  Lethal Torrent, causing the Twin Grakatas to have a higher DPS.
Mods that affect the standalone Grakata, such as  Wild Frenzy and Riven Mods, cannot be equipped on the Twin Grakatas.

Trivia
The Twin Grakatas were first presented in the Echoes of the Sentients Highlight Video.
The Twin Grakatas appear to have been inspired by a popular fan-made comic by Datareaper (who was the designer of the  Kronen) involving a Grineer Lancer named Clem, who idolizes the Tenno and is seen wielding two Grakatas as his signature weapon.
The Twin Grakatas are the first weapons to occupy a different weapon slot to their default counterpart - while the single Grakata is a primary weapon, the Twin Grakatas are considered secondary weapons and thus use pistol mods instead of rifle mods.
The Twin Grakatas are the first dual-wielded version of another weapon to fire more projectiles at once instead of having increased magazine size and fire rate.
The Twin Grakatas possess the highest possible ammo reserve (2280 with the  Trick Mag mod) of all equippable weapons, barring Archwing weapons which have an infinite reserve.
Tied with  Dual Cestra and  Secura Dual Cestra for the largest magazine size of all secondaries.
Lowest damage per bullet of all secondaries.

Bugs
If the player owns a  Prisma Grakata the game will display it as an available material for building the Twin Grakatas, despite the fact that it cannot be selected.
